description: This file contains the implementation of the ModifyAttributeLiveCommand interface, specifically an immutable class that modifies an attribute in a live command context. It includes methods for constructing instances, accessing attribute details, setting headers, and identifying the command category.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the ModifyAttributeLiveCommand interface that allows modification of an attribute as a live command.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyAttributeLiveCommandImpl from a generic Command object, casting it to ModifyAttribute.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the attribute's location.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the new value for the attribute.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization, returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder instance for forming responses to this command.
